text:
emma-cs: Heads-up: Lumen onboarding stuck on init step. They see bursts of 429s during their CI warmup and during first real-user traffic. Cutover scheduled tomorrow, they need a quick unblock.
ryan-eng: Any logs? 429s on which endpoint?
emma-cs: Preflight/init. Customer pasted this snippet: 
```
POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/preflight
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
X-Redwood-Region: eu-central-1
Response: 429 {\"error\":\"rate_limit\", \"retry_after\":2}
```
mateo-cs: They9re on rn-mobile-sdk v0.9.2 and ramping 12 parallel warmup jobs in CI. Also seeing sporadic 401s when ephemeral tokens rotate at the same time.
dev-rel: Typical pattern: simultaneous token refresh + preflight fanout -> tenant bucket exhausted. Immediate mitigation we recommend to customers: 1) set region/edge explicitly at init, 2) stagger token refreshes across instances with jitter, 3) reduce warmup concurrency to <=5.
onboard-engineer: RN snippet we can send: 
```js
Redwood.init({
  apiKey: '__ephemeral__',
  region: 'eu-central-1',
  preflight: { maxConcurrency: 4 },
  auth: { refreshJitterMs: 300 },
  retry: { maxRetries: 4 }
});
```
ryan-eng: On infra side, options: A) accept X-Redwood-Region header as fallback for preflight, B) temporary tenant cap bump, C) route their IPs to eu-central pool. Need ops ticket for B/C.
emma-cs: Asked customer for traceroute + tenant id. They returned IPs: 34.83.12.45, 35.204.4.10, 203.0.113.45. Tenant = t-lumen-21.
ops-bot: anomaly detected: tenant=t-lumen-21 spike @2026-03-24T09:12:23Z  concurrent_preflight=14 token_rotate_window=6s.
mateo-cs: Customer is OK with temporary bump if needed. They prefer SDK workaround first since they control CI.
dev-rel: Also push them to upgrade to rn-mobile-sdk v1.0.0 (fixes concurrent refresh race and lowers default preflight concurrency). v1.0.0 includes randomized backoff for ephemeral refresh.
ryan-eng: I'll propose short-term measures: enable region-header fallback for preflight on canary and put a 24h cap increase for t-lumen-21 if requested. Ops sign-off needed.
onboard-engineer: Filing ticket now with IPs and tenant. Please tag infra and edge.
ops-bot: ticket INC-9501 created: request temporary preflight cap bump and routing exception for t-lumen-21 until 2026-03-25T10:00:00Z.
emma-cs: Sent RN snippet + upgrade recommendation to customer and asked them to throttle CI warmups to 3 concurrent jobs and add jitter to their refresh.
mateo-cs: Will monitor metrics. Please report when INC-9501 is applied.
ops-bot: update: INC-9501 approved and cap increased to 60 for t-lumen-21. Monitor for 24h.
ryan-eng: Follow-up: I9ll add a short onboarding note about region pinning + token jitter and link to SDK upgrade.
emma-cs: Thanks everyone. I9ll confirm with the customer after their cutover tomorrow and post a short retro in onboarding channel.
